reader_summary.headline: James Davolos discusses capital-light real assets and investing during higher inflation.
reader_summary.overview: James Davolos shares his journey as an investor and explains Horizon Kinetics' long-term approach. He highlights why capital-light businesses work well when inflation stays high. The conversation covers specific examples like land and royalty companies.

key_points.text: Capital-light, real asset businesses perform well when inflation remains structurally higher.
Royalty companies offer the best opportunities during a bear market.
key_points.evidence_quote: The best time to be a royalty company is in a bear market

key_points.text: Investors should focus on localised inflation rather than broad inflation trends.

reader_summary.why_it_matters: Listeners learn which types of businesses fit a high-inflation environment.
